project.name: Recommendation Engine v2 — New Rules, Configurable Thresholds, Unit Price

summary: Extends the SpendCube recommendation engine with three new rule types and per-engagement configurable thresholds. (1) SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK fires when a single supplier holds >80% of a multi-supplier category — a risk signal complementary to COMPETITIVE_TENDER (which fires on single-source only). (2) EARLY_PAYMENT_DISCOUNT_CAPTURE uses the existing has_early_payment_discount/discount_percent fields already on the transactions table to quantify untapped early-pay discount value. (3) BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION benchmarks unit prices across suppliers in the same L3 category — gracefully no-ops when unit_price is absent, which requires adding unit_price and unit_of_measure as optional nullable transaction columns. All rule thresholds (payment days target, WACC, consolidation threshold, etc.) become per-engagement overrides stored in a new recommendation_config_json column on the engagements table, editable via GET/PATCH /recommendations/config endpoints and a frontend settings panel on the Recommendations page. The frontend column_mapping-to-ingestor bug (mapping sent but not used by ingest_to_raw) is noted in risks but out of scope.

decisions.threshold_storage: Per-engagement overrides stored as a JSON blob in engagements.recommendation_config_json. Engine loads and merges at run time via setattr on config.recommendations. Keeps config.yaml as the global default — no new tables needed.
decisions.config_api_location: GET/PATCH /recommendations/config added to the existing recommendations router (backend/app/routers/recommendations.py) — follows existing patterns and prefix /api/engagements/{engagement_id}/recommendations, avoids a new router file.
decisions.new_rule_exclusive_groups: SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK goes into SOURCING_CONCENTRATION (separate from SOURCING where SUPPLIER_CONSOLIDATION and COMPETITIVE_TENDER live — they fire on different conditions so do not double-count). EARLY_PAYMENT_DISCOUNT_CAPTURE goes into EARLY_PAYMENT. BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION goes into PRICE_BENCHMARK.
decisions.best_price_savings_formula: estimated_saving = price_gap_pct * category_spend * addressability_pct, where price_gap_pct = (avg_unit_price - best_unit_price) / avg_unit_price. Avoids needing a quantity column and works from unit price plus spend data only.
decisions.savings_rates_passthrough: EARLY_PAYMENT_DISCOUNT_CAPTURE and BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION set saving_pct: 1.0 in savings_rates.yaml. These rules compute the impact directly (discount_amount and price_gap respectively) — a rates saving_pct of 1.0 passes through the computed value unchanged. addressability_pct still applies.
decisions.concentration_risk_threshold: Default 80% top-supplier share. Only fires when n_suppliers > 1 (no overlap with COMPETITIVE_TENDER). Category spend must exceed competitive_tender_min_spend (reuses existing config value to avoid a new threshold).
decisions.column_mapping_bug_out_of_scope: frontend UploadPage sends column_mapping to the backend but _run_pipeline in ingestion.py does not pass it to ingest_to_raw(). Fixing this is out of scope. unit_price will only populate if the CSV column is literally named unit_price.

existing_tables.engagements: Has recommendations_json TEXT and llm_dry_run BOOLEAN. Sprint adds recommendation_config_json TEXT (nullable) for per-engagement threshold overrides.
existing_tables.transactions: Has has_early_payment_discount INTEGER, discount_percent FLOAT, discount_days INTEGER already in both src/models/database.py transactions_table and CanonicalTransaction in src/models/schema.py. Sprint adds unit_price DOUBLE PRECISION and unit_of_measure TEXT as nullable columns.

patterns_to_follow: New rules: method named rule_X() on RecommendationRules; check required columns; call self._addressable(txn); iterate groupby; call self._rates.get(TYPE, category); return list[dict] with all 8 standard fields (type, context, evidence, estimated_impact_aud, confidence, action, lever) plus 4 audit trail fields (baseline_spend, addressability_pct, saving_pct, addressable_baseline).

Engine override: self._apply_engagement_overrides() queries SELECT recommendation_config_json FROM engagements WHERE id = :eid using self.engine.connect(); parses JSON; calls setattr(self.config.recommendations, key, value) for each key where hasattr(self.config.recommendations, key) is True.

Backend config endpoints: call verify_engagement_ownership first; load config defaults via load_config(config_path); query engagements for recommendation_config_json; merge and return. PATCH updates the JSON column.

Frontend settings panel: useRecommendationConfig(engagementId) hook for data; useState for each field initialised from config in useEffect; Save calls saveConfig with local state values (dividing displayed percentages by 100 for fractional fields like wacc, tail_spend_alert_pct, maverick_alert_pct, concentration_threshold_pct) then runMutation.mutate().

EXCLUSIVE_GROUPS in deduplicator.py: pool_key for per-category rules is (context, exclusive_group); for PORTFOLIO_* rules it is ('PORTFOLIO', exclusive_group). New rules are per-category so use (context, exclusive_group) pattern.
Migration: ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pattern — no DROP, no DEFAULT constraints needed for nullable columns.

userStories.title: Add GET /config and PATCH /config endpoints to recommendations router
userStories.description: Add two endpoints to backend/app/routers/recommendations.py. GET /config returns the current per-engagement recommendation thresholds as a flat dict (config.yaml defaults merged with any recommendation_config_json overrides stored on the engagement row). PATCH /config accepts a partial RecommendationConfigUpdate Pydantic body, merges the non-None fields into the existing stored JSON, and persists to engagements.recommendation_config_json. Both endpoints call verify_engagement_ownership and load_config() using the SPENDCUBE_CONFIG_PATH env var.

userStories.title: Add SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK rule
userStories.description: Add rule method rule_spend_concentration_risk() to RecommendationRules in src/recommendations/rules.py. Fires when a L2 category has more than one supplier AND the top supplier holds more than cfg.concentration_threshold_pct (default 0.80) of category spend AND category_spend > cfg.competitive_tender_min_spend. The saving represents the risk mitigation cost of establishing a second source. n_suppliers must be > 1 to avoid overlap with COMPETITIVE_TENDER (which fires on exactly 1 supplier).
acceptanceCriteria: Edit file: src/recommendations/rules.py — add constant at the top with other constants: SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK = 'SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK'

Edit file: src/recommendations/rules.py — add rule_spend_concentration_risk() method to RecommendationRules class with this logic: (1) get txn from self.cube.get('transactions', pd.DataFrame()); check required columns {'category_l2', 'canonical_supplier_id', 'base_amount'} are all in txn.columns; (2) addr = self._addressable(txn); addr_cat = addr.dropna(subset=['category_l2']); (3) for category, group in addr_cat.groupby('category_l2'): n_suppliers = int(group['canonical_supplier_id'].nunique()); skip if n_suppliers <= 1; category_spend = float(group['base_amount'].sum()); skip if category_spend <= cfg.competitive_tender_min_spend; supplier_spend = group.groupby('canonical_supplier_id')['base_amount'].sum(); top_supplier_pct = float(supplier_spend.max() / category_spend); skip if top_supplier_pct <= cfg.concentration_threshold_pct; get top_supplier_id = supplier_spend.idxmax(); get top_supplier_name from group where canonical_supplier_id == top_supplier_id using canonical_supplier_name column if present; rates_row = self._rates.get(SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK, str(category)); saving_pct = rates_row['saving_pct']; addressability_pct = rates_row['addressability_pct']; addressable_baseline = category_spend * addressability_pct; estimated_impact = addressable_baseline * saving_pct; append dict with all required fields

userStories.title: Add EARLY_PAYMENT_DISCOUNT_CAPTURE rule
userStories.description: Add rule_early_payment_discount_capture() to RecommendationRules in src/recommendations/rules.py. Uses the existing has_early_payment_discount (INTEGER, 1=yes) and discount_percent (FLOAT, e.g. 2.5 means 2.5%) columns already on the transactions table. For each supplier with eligible transactions, annual_discount_opportunity = SUM(base_amount * discount_percent / 100). Apply addressability_pct from rates. Only fire when addressable_opportunity > cfg.min_discount_opportunity (default $1,000). Since saving_pct in savings_rates.yaml is 1.0 for this rule type, estimated_impact = annual_discount_opportunity * addressability_pct * 1.0.

userStories.title: Add BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION rule
userStories.description: Add rule_best_price_extrapolation() to RecommendationRules in src/recommendations/rules.py. Groups transactions by category_l3 (falls back to category_l2 if l3 absent) where unit_price is non-null and > 0. For each group with >= cfg.min_price_benchmark_transactions rows AND >= 2 distinct suppliers: compute price_gap_pct = (avg_unit_price - best_unit_price) / avg_unit_price; estimated_saving = price_gap_pct * category_spend * addressability_pct. Returns [] immediately if unit_price column is absent or all null — this is the no-op graceful fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit file: src/recommendations/rules.py — add constant: BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION = 'BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION'

Edit file: src/recommendations/rules.py — add rule_best_price_extrapolation() method: (1) if 'unit_price' not in txn.columns: return []; (2) addr = self._addressable(txn); priced = addr[addr['unit_price'].notna() & (addr['unit_price'] > 0)]; if priced.empty: return []; (3) group_col = 'category_l3' if ('category_l3' in priced.columns and priced['category_l3'].notna().any()) else 'category_l2'; priced_cat = priced.dropna(subset=[group_col]); if priced_cat.empty: return []; (4) cfg = self._rec_cfg; recs = []; for category, group in priced_cat.groupby(group_col): if len(group) < cfg.min_price_benchmark_transactions: continue; n_suppliers = int(group['canonical_supplier_id'].nunique()); if n_suppliers < 2: continue; best_price = float(group['unit_price'].min()); avg_price = float(group['unit_price'].mean()); if avg_price <= best_price: continue; price_gap_pct = (avg_price - best_price) / avg_price; category_spend = float(addr[addr[group_col] == category]['base_amount'].sum()); if category_spend <= 0: continue; rates_row = self._rates.get(BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION, str(category)); addressability_pct = rates_row['addressability_pct']; addressable_baseline = category_spend * addressability_pct; estimated_impact = price_gap_pct * addressable_baseline; confidence = 'HIGH' if len(group) >= 20 else 'MEDIUM'; append rec dict

Edit file: src/recommendations/rules.py — the recommendation dict for BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION must include: type=BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION, context=str(category), evidence=f'Best unit price: {best_price:.2f}; avg unit price: {avg_price:.2f}; gap: {price_gap_pct:.1%} across {n_suppliers} suppliers ({len(group)} transactions)', action=f'Standardise sourcing for {category} to best-price supplier or negotiate to best observed rate', lever='Best Price Extrapolation', confidence=confidence, baseline_spend=round(category_spend, 2), addressability_pct=addressability_pct, saving_pct=None, addressable_baseline=round(addressable_baseline, 2)

checks: cd frontend && npm run build — zero TypeScript errors
supabase/migrations/004_recommendation_engine_v2.sql exists and contains exactly 3 ALTER TABLE statements
GET /recommendations/config returns a flat dict containing concentration_threshold_pct key
PATCH /recommendations/config with {target_payment_days: 60} persists and is reflected in subsequent GET
Recommendations page shows a Configure button that toggles a settings form with labeled inputs

risks: column_mapping bug: frontend UploadPage column_mapping dict is sent to backend but _run_pipeline in ingestion.py does not pass it to ingest_to_raw(). unit_price mapping from the UI will be silently ignored — BEST_PRICE rule only fires if the CSV column is literally named unit_price. Fixing this bug is out of scope for this sprint.

EARLY_PAYMENT_DISCOUNT_CAPTURE and BEST_PRICE_EXTRAPOLATION saving_pct must be 1.0 in savings_rates.yaml. These rules compute impact directly — if saving_pct were 0.08, the already-computed discount amount would be multiplied again, causing a 92% underestimate. Ralph must not use a non-1.0 saving_pct for these two rule types.

concentration_threshold_pct must be added to BOTH src/config.py RecommendationsConfig class AND config.yaml in US-004. If only one is updated, load_config() Pydantic validation will fail with a missing field error.

_apply_engagement_overrides() must wrap its DB query in try/except. In test environments with SQLite in-memory DBs that have no engagements table, the query will raise an OperationalError and should log a warning and return rather than crashing the engine.

setattr on Pydantic v2 model fields: RecommendationsConfig does not have model_config=ConfigDict(frozen=True), so setattr should work directly. If future Pydantic upgrades make models immutable by default, the pattern would need to change to model_copy(update={...}).

SPEND_CONCENTRATION_RISK reuses cfg.competitive_tender_min_spend as its spend threshold to avoid adding yet another config parameter. This means lowering the competitive tender threshold also lowers the concentration risk threshold — document this coupling.
